messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: clang++: unsigned comparison warnings
parts:
It turns out that the -Wall (turn all warnings on) flag doesn't actually turn on all errors.

If you want to see the comparison warnings that g++ on Windows is giving us, add -Wsign-compare to your compiler flags.



Daniel

I typically start with that and then turn off errors that I know are not
a problem.
